texto: In a schedule, **abfahren** indicates the output; **Gleis** identifies the track. Do not confuse **ab** (from) with **an** (arrival).

frases.de: Der Zug nach Berlin fährt um neun Uhr ab.
frases.es: El tren a Berlín sale a las nueve.
frases.en: The train to Berlin leaves at nine.

frases.de: Die Abfahrt ist auf Gleis drei.
frases.es: La salida es desde la vía tres.
frases.en: The exit is from track three.
We bought tickets at the station.

bloques.pregunta: Where's the train mentioned on the front line?

opciones.explicacion: The text accurately indicates «Der Zug nach Berlin».
That city is not mentioned in that line.
The Austrian capital does not appear on schedule.

bloques.pregunta: What time does the train leave for Berlin?

opciones.explicacion: The first line indicates «fährt um neun Uhr ab».
Three is the track or platform number («Gleis drei»).
The text says the bus is the one that comes later.

bloques.pregunta: From what way does the train or platform make its way out?

opciones.explicacion: The second line indicates «auf Gleis drei».
Nine is the time of departure.

opciones.texto: The schedule does not specify the platform.
opciones.explicacion: The track is explicitly indicated.

bloques.pregunta: What means of transport come later according to the notice?

opciones.explicacion: The third line says «Der Bus kommt später».
The train leaves at nine.
No tram is mentioned in the text.

bloques.pregunta: Where do the passengers buy the tickets?

opciones.explicacion: The last line says «Wir kaufen Fahrkarten am Bahnhof».
The bus is not indicated as a point of sale.
Berlin is the city of destination.

bloques.pregunta: In the «fährt … ab» expression, what grammatical phenomenon occurs with the «ab» prefix?

opciones.texto: The verb is separable and its prefix is moved at the end of the main prayer.
opciones.explicacion: Right.

opciones.texto: The prefix is placed in front of the subject.
opciones.explicacion: No.

opciones.texto: The prefix is completely removed when conjugating in present time.
opciones.explicacion: No.

bloques.frase: Der Zug fährt um neun Uhr ___ . (sale)

opciones.explicacion: In the «abfahren» separable verb, the «ab» prefix closes the sentence.
It would correspond to «ankommen» (arrive).
This is not the case with the railway output verb.

bloques.frase: Die Abfahrt ist auf Gleis drei.

opciones.texto: The exit is from track three.
opciones.explicacion: «Die Abfahrt» means output and «Gleis drei» indicates track three.

opciones.texto: The train is on platform three.
opciones.explicacion: Arrival would be «die Ankunft».
There's no talk of any cancellation.

intro: Look for destination and time of departure; then check the track and if there are changes.
